subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution required'.**

The only course of action to (fend of the loud clamour off conspiracy theories) is to keep everyone fully informed.

options.text: fend off the loud clamour of conspiracy theories
fend off the loud clamour off conspiracy theories
fend of the loud clamour of conspiracy theories

solution:
The correct answer is **"fend off the loud clamour of conspiracy theories."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence contains a grammatical error with the use of **'off'** and **'of.'**
 
• **"Off"** must be used after **"fend" **and** "of"** must be used after **"of."**
 
• The correct phrase is **'fend off'** which means to defend against something. (किसी चीज़ से बचाव करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *Meredith tried frantically to **fend him off**__.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the only way to defend against these theories is by providing full information. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **'Loud clamour'** refers to a noisy outcry or protest. (शोर-शराबा या विरोध प्रदर्शन)
 
• **'Conspiracy theories'** are beliefs that suggest a secret plot or scheme. (षड्यंत्र के सिद्धांत)
